purpose: Teach: 引き取り/製法/未納/受け皿/賭ける/画策/押し付ける/強いる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 退職社員の業務、本気で、絶対、引き取り、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to take full responsibility for the retiring employee's work. Be thorough. Don't cut corners.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Crisp attack on the opening word. Firm but not raised — this is instruction, not anger. Slight weight on the key imperatives. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社独自の、本気で、絶対、製法、絶対、社外秘、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're maintaining our proprietary production methods with full confidentiality and attention to detail, sir. Thank you for entrusting us with this.
lines.style: Respectful, methodical cadence. Each key point lands with quiet precision. Warm gratitude in the closer — not overstated, just genuine. Slight bow in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様の、本気で、絶対、未納、絶対、督促、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When customers fall behind on payments, I want collection handled with care and professionalism. No corners cut there either.
lines.style: Clear directive. Measured pace. The word 'care' gets a subtle emphasis — this isn't about being harsh. Steady and reasonable, not threatening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の声、本気で、絶対、受け皿、絶対、当社、絶対、整えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We've set up proper channels to listen to customer feedback and concerns. We're on it.
lines.style: Calm, attentive delivery. Acknowledging the weight of what's being asked. Confident but not casual — this matters and he knows it matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 勝負所に、本気で、絶対、賭ける、絶対、覚悟を、絶対、持て、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When it comes to critical moments, I need you all to be ready to commit fully. No hesitation.
lines.style: Slightly heavier. The word 'ready' carries quiet intensity. Not aggressive, but the expectation is clear. Pause weight before the closing phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合の、本気で、絶対、画策、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're keeping close watch on what our competitors are doing so we stay ahead. You have my word.
lines.style: Steady and alert. The phrase 'keeping close watch' gets focused attention. Ending with quiet resolve — not defensive, just watchful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 責任を、本気で、絶対、人に、絶対、押し付ける、絶対、ような社員、絶対、許さんぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I won't tolerate anyone dumping their responsibilities onto others. That's not how we operate here.
lines.style: Firmer now. Clean attack. The word 'tolerate' gets a decisive edge. This is about values, not just procedure. Quiet but unmistakable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に無理を、本気で、絶対、強いる、絶対、ことなく、絶対、適切な、絶対、業務量、絶対、保っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We make sure the team isn't overloaded with unreasonable demands. We keep workloads fair and sustainable.
lines.style: Grounded and thoughtful. Closing with conviction — these aren't empty words but actual practice. Slight warmth underneath the professionalism.
